verdict.rationale: Weave documents a core `Evaluation` object that runs a `Dataset` against scorers for repeatable offline tests (docs-6, docs-31), with built-in and custom scorers (docs-7, docs-8). The marketing site claims you can test models against production traces (docs-21), and tracing captures inputs and outputs of production calls (docs-4). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the workflow for selecting or exporting traces into a versioned Dataset, and independent or hands-on corroboration of trace-to-dataset curation.
